title:
Basic test data for Reliability.

As with other C3 applications, it is recommended to
increase java memory and cassandra heap size on your
local server when loading this data:
```
export VM_MIN_MEM=15G
export VM_MAX_MEM=20G
export MAX_HEAP_SIZE=5G
export HEAP_NEWSIZE=5G
```
name: ReliabilityTestData
